paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Zavda. Rav Yehudah said: R. Abba said: R. Yehudah bar Zavda said: Rav said—Kiddushin 73b. R. Abbahu ben Zutrati said in the name of R. Yehudah bar Zevida, Berakhot 12b. See also Bava Batra 120a. [Bava Batra quotes Rav Yehudah bar Zevida directly.] Rav Huna ruled for Rav Yehudah bar Zavdi's brother: Jerusalem Talmud, Megallechin, halakhah 5. R. Abba and R. Simon, his brothers. [The Jerusalem Kiddushin and Bava Batra parallels respectively give Abba and Simon for the same teaching.] R. Shmuel bar Nachman, in his name: Jerusalem Berakhot.
